Since MOON mentions the reapers in people's heads, for people names 
like .FASL. OUTPUT and .UNFA. OUTPUT would be better than _FASL_ OUTPUT 
and _UNFA_ OUTPUT as every now and then people list their directories 
from the top, and they are perhaps more likely to flush these files 
when they see them.  In fact, I have long wished TECO used 
.TECO. OUTPUT rather than _TECO_ OUTPUT for this reason.  (Does anyone 
out there still generate such files besides me?)
